items.text: Nu kes alosito nuka idwe luka Isirael, nakenyounioto kakwap nako Misiri toma ajoresiokee kama ka Musa ka Aaron.
Kiwadik Musa anyounonetakee kwape ajaar alositekee kaieorakinet naka EJAKAIT: nu kes alositokee kwape ajaatar anyounonetakec.
Konyout koRameses kolap losodit, kapaaran nakitomonet kakany naka elap losodit; kapaaran naatupakini Aleleŋio kolomasi idwe luka Isirael kakan naarioro kakonyen nuka Imisirian kere.
Napeidaete Imisirian lukiyaikikee kere, luabu EJAKAIT kodany kotomakec: kotubok EJAKAIT ikeeedekesio da.
Kolototo idwe luka Isirael anyoun koRameses kidukuroto Sukot.
Kolototo anyoun koSukot kidukuroto Etam, naejai ariri naka amodiŋ.
Kolototo anyoun koEtam, kibelooros kiton Pi-kakirot naitei Baal-sepon: kidukuroto akonyen nuka Migidol.
Kolototo anyoun kakonyen nuka Kakirot kitoro kidin aŋolol kiton amodiŋ: koloto alosit naka apaarasia auni kamodiŋ naka Etam, kidukuroto Mara.
Kolototo anyoun koMara kodolut Elim: ajaas toma Elim atanin atomon kaarei ka idukudukun akaisakanykaarei; kidukuroto nen.
Kolototo anyoun koElim, kidukuroto ariri naka Aŋolol Nakarenan.
Kolototo anyoun kAŋolol Nakarenan, kidukuroto amodiŋ naka Sin.
Kolototo anyoun kamodiŋ naka Sin, kidukuroto Dopuka,
Kolototo anyoun kAlus, kidukuroto Repidim, neamamikiniata ituŋa akip numatan.
Kolototo anyoun koRepidim, kidukuroto amodiŋ naka Sinai.
Kolototo anyoun kamodiŋ naka Sinai, kidukuroto Kiburotkataaba,
Kolototo anyoun koKekelata, kidukuroto moru Seper.
Kolototo anyoun komoru Seper, kidukuroto Karada,
Kolototo anyoun koEsiongeber, kidukuroto amodiŋ naka Sin (nipenin ŋes Kades),
Kolototo anyoun koKades, kidukuroto moru Kor, ariri naka akwap naka Edom,
Kodoka Aaron esasedoti moru Kor kaieorakinet naka EJAKAIT, kotwanik nen, kokaru lokakaisaoŋon kedaut idwe luka Isirael anyoun kakwap nako Misiri, kolap lokikanyet, kapaaran kanasodit naka elap,
Kerai Aaron loka ikar akwatat ka akaisaarei ka luuni etwanikini moru Kor.
Kopup do Ekanaanit, ekabaka loka Arad, loeboienenei kari naka Eŋalakimak naka akwap nako Kanaan abunore naka idwe luka Isirael.
Kolototo anyoun komoru Kor, kidukuroto Salimona.
Kolototo anyoun koObot, kidukuroto Iyeabarim, koikor loka Moab.
Kolototo anyoun koAlumon-dibilataim, kidukuroto oroŋan luka Abarim, eiteo ka Nebo.
Kolototo anyoun koroŋan luka Abarim, kidukuroto apuutona nuka Moab ariri naka Yorodan koYeriko.
Kidukuroto ariri naka Yorodan anyoun koBet-yesimot aitodol Abel-sitim kapuutona nuka Moab.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa kapuutona nuka Moab kariri naka Yorodan koYeriko atiar,
“Kiner kidwe luka Isirael, kolimok kes ebe, Kidokata yesi Yorodan kodolo akwap naka Kanaan.
Irenearete luiboienenete kakwap kere kakonyenekus, imudiarete akecemor kere nuigirir, ka akeceputosia nuiswamatai kasua, imudiarete da akeeeiboisio nuiceleleete.
Irumete yesi akwap, ibojenenete da kanen, naarai kainak yes airum akwap.

Irumete yesi akwap kailamilam eroet kwape ejaatar ikekiakus; iinakinete luipu airumet naepol, ka luikidioko iinakinete airumet naedit, naebeikinia ituŋanan eroet, eraun ŋin naken; irumete ŋes kwape ejaatar atekerin nuka lukapapaakus.

Konye arai mam irenearete kakonyenekus luiboienenete kakwap, esalete do nul luitasalete yesi esubito bala ibore yenedopodopoi akusikonye, bala da ikukwa kosiepionokus, kitunyunyurikinete yes kakwap naiboienenete yesi kotoma.
Ejaun do ebe, kwape tikaomitor eoŋ aiswamakin kes, keswamakini yes da kwape kwaŋin.”
